name: Cityscape & Urban Scene
description: A curated combination of scene, composition, lighting, style, and quality keywords for generating dramatic cityscape and urban environment images. Ranges from photorealistic city photography to stylized cyberpunk/neon aesthetics, using atmospheric conditions and golden/blue hour lighting.
description_zh: 精心搭配场景、构图、灯光、风格和质量关键词，生成戏剧性城市景观和城市场景图像。从写实城市摄影到赛博朋克/霓虹美学，使用大气条件和黄金/蓝色时刻灯光。
prompt_text: masterpiece, best quality, highly detailed, high resolution, sharp focus, city skyline, bustling city street, night sky, sunset, cyberpunk lighting, moody atmosphere, cinematic lighting, teal and orange palette, high contrast, ultra-wide angle
prompt_text_zh: 杰作，最高质量，高细节，高分辨率，清晰聚焦，城市天际线，繁忙城市街道，夜空，日落，赛博朋克灯光，情绪氛围，电影感灯光，青橙调色板，高对比度，超广角

example.description: Generate a dramatic cityscape of Tokyo at golden hour with neon accents.
example.description_zh: 生成黄金时段带有霓虹元素的东京戏剧性城市景观。
example.output: masterpiece, best quality, highly detailed, high resolution, sharp focus, city skyline, Tokyo skyline with neon-lit streets, bustling city street, night sky, golden hour lighting, cinematic lighting, ultra-wide angle

notes: This bundle covers urban and cityscape photography from photorealistic to stylized. Key differentiators: city_skyline (0.9) + bustling_city_street (0.8) form the core. Golden hour (0.9) + cyberpunk lighting (0.85) + moody atmosphere (0.85) for dramatic mood. Ultra-wide angle (0.9) is key for dramatic cityscapes. film_noir (0.8) for noir styling. Note: no exact 'scene_nature_skyline' or 'scene_city_buildings' keywords exist; closest is 'city_skyline_seen_from_rooftop' (0.9).
